## Checklist

- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm validate:modules` is green.
- [ ] If this changes a published package, I have run `pnpm changeset`.
- [ ] If this adds or modifies a module, an eval test is included and passes.
- [ ] If this introduces a dependency, I have justified it in this description.
- [ ] If this changes voice or docs surfaces, I have re-read the voice rules in [`Lokomotif-Kit.md`](../Lokomotif-Kit.md) and Brief § 11.
